reference: APT28 (G0007) USES LSASS Memory (T1003.001), which is MITIGATED_BY User Training (M1017). This is a recorded association, not proof that the mitigation prevents every occurrence.
answer: LSASS Memory (T1003.001) is linked to LAMEHUG (S9035) as reported for APT28, and the two-edge evidence path is: APT28 (G0007) uses LAMEHUG (S9035) (USES) -> APT28 (G0007) uses LSASS Memory (T1003.001) (USES).
